title: Pathavi Pramanam
desc: Siva breaks out of prison after unsuccessfully trying to kill a politician. He later bypasses the politician's security, kidnaps him, and goes to a television station to reveal his motives.

title: Paarvai Ondre Pothume
desc: A young man becomes successful through his hard work and helps his best friend by offering him a job. However, their friendship sees upheavals when both of them fall in love with the same girl.

title: Mahanadhi
desc: An honest man, Krishnaswamy, is deceived by a chit fund scam and wrongfully imprisoned. Subsequently, as his family falls apart, he endures immense hardships in jail.

title: Little John
desc: To please his girlfriend's parents, an American seeks the help of a guru to make him invisible. However, he shrinks and must find a special ring to restore himself to his normal size.

title: Kushi
desc: After separation due to a misconception between two college friends, their egos contain them from reuniting despite being romantically involved.
